propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project tickets, causing tickets to read as absent-project with no fallback on upgrade, breaking sync
Migration must seed the projects mapping with legacy_default and one projects entry from Backend.project without writing ticket events
Ensure units must be idempotent, check-then-act, and converge on init/re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot without contending the store lock
A one-project mapping must leave required_capabilities empty; a multi-project mapping must add exactly multi-project-bridge token
The sweep must write zero ticket events and leave the tickets-branch tip SHA unchanged on re-run
Two-project stamped stores must still pass check_store_compat on this binary even though multi-project-bridge is added to KNOWN_CAPABILITIES
